name: smwpatches-new-super-mario-bros-wii-level-intro
title: New Super Mario Bros Wii - Level Intro
description:
This patch adds the classic NSMBW's Level Intro, where both your Lives and a simple level preview appear. The Readme explains everything you need to know for proper insertion and how to configure every possible aspect in this patch.

This zip comes with lots of files but you should apply only NSMBWLevIntro.asm.

Give credit if used.
